title: Dawn till Dusk at my Rural Cottage - Homemaking Vlog
en: my dreams are like the tamarack trees glowing amber with needles of gold under a hunter's moon i dance with the dryads and they tell me their secrets the mountain slopes are vigilant and so i become anticipating the frost and the diminishing light so

do october is a month of change and i find myself quite excited for the cold weather it is an opportunity to prepare one's mind for a period of rest i take great inspiration from animals during this time many are gathering food knowing what is to come they will diminish as the snow comes and

patiently wait i as well consider what it is that i truly need in my life be it good company more sleep a clean space i do my best to prepare for both the time of hardship and renewal but i also think about my heart and what feelings need to be cultivated there one thing that has been on my mind recently is wishing for a world that is more compassionate i've always been sensitive and empathetic by nature

sometimes to a fault but i know that i can be even more compassionate because every day i'm reminded of this by the children i work with my job as a teacher gives me an opportunity to practice empathy every day indeed when a two-year-old has been crying over a scraped knee for an hour it can be quite exhausting but in those moments i remember that that scrape knee may very well be the worst pain they have ever experienced in their short lifetime considering that the reaction seems suddenly appropriate i think we can apply this same concept to adults as well we are each on our own journey many of

us have endured different types of hardship and pain but it feels different for each of us since the experience is unique and we are all in need of compassionate words and actions no one is stronger or weaker due to their emotional or less emotional spirit i believe our strength is shown through our actions towards others not how often we cry do

as you can see today is one of my days off i'm not working and therefore i'm left to my own devices i deeply enjoy these days by myself even though i welcome a future where a family and children takes up more of my time but right now this is where i am in my life and i wish to take full advantage of each delicious minute i spend it working on my crafts cooking painting but most importantly daydreaming have you recently spent a moment simply with your own thoughts letting your imagination take flight to places you have never seen before it is one of my favorite pastimes one that children seem to innately

understand i implore you to never stop daydreaming in moments where the harsh realities of the world find me feeling anger and despair this is healing i spend time every day nursing a vibrant imagination and rich spiritual life these are two things that are so separate and yet for me also innately intertwined they both involve seeing the world as full of goodness as it is in need of compassion a peaceful coexistence is possible because i've seen it in my heart spirit and mind even if it is not yet tangible in the real world as the cold sets in and i prepare to hibernate in my free time
i know that i will spend much of it dreaming and i hope you will too do you
zh: 我的梦想就像落叶松树在猎人的月亮下闪烁着琥珀色的金针我与树妖共舞，他们告诉我他们的秘密山坡保持警惕，所以我开始期待霜冻和逐渐减弱的光线
十月是一个充满变化的月份，我发现自己对寒冷的天气感到非常兴奋，这是一个让自己的思想准备一段时间休息的机会，在这段时间里，我从动物身上得到了很大的启发，许多人正在收集食物，知道接下来会发生什么，随着雪的到来，它们会减少，
耐心等待，我也考虑一下我生命中真正需要的是什么，是好的陪伴，还是睡觉，是一个干净的空间，我尽力为困难时期和更新做好准备，但我也思考我的内心，需要培养什么情感，最近我脑子里一直在想的一件事是希望有一个更有同情心的世界，我生性一直很敏感和善解人意。
有时是错误的，但我知道我可以更加富有同情心，因为每天我和我一起工作的孩子们都会提醒我这一点，老师的工作给了我每天练习同理心的机会，确实，当一个两岁的孩子为擦伤的膝盖哭泣一个小时时，这可能会让人筋疲力尽，但在那些时刻，我记得擦伤的膝盖很可能是他们在短暂的一生中经历过的最严重的疼痛，考虑到这种反应突然看起来很合适，我想我们也可以将同样的概念应用到成年人身上我们每个人都在自己的旅程中
我们经历过不同类型的艰难和痛苦，但我们每个人的感觉都不同，因为经历是独特的，我们都需要富有同情心的言语和行动，没有人会因为情绪化或情绪化的精神而变得更强或更弱，我相信我们的力量是通过我们对他人的行为表现出来的，而不是我们哭泣的频率
正如你所看到的，今天是我休息的日子之一，我没有工作，因此我只能依靠自己的设备，我非常享受独自一人的日子，尽管我欢迎一个家庭和孩子占据我更多时间的未来，但现在这就是我生活中的情况，我希望充分利用每一分钟，我把它花在我的手工艺烹饪绘画上，但最重要的是做白日梦，你最近是否花了一点时间简单地思考自己的想法，让你的想象力飞向你以前从未见过的地方，这是我的梦想之一孩子们似乎与生俱来最喜欢的消遣之一
我恳求你永远不要停止做白日梦，当世界的严酷现实让我感到愤怒和绝望时，这是一种治愈，我每天花时间护理充满活力的想象力和丰富的精神生活，这是两件事，如此独立，但对我来说又本质上交织在一起，它们都涉及到看到世界充满善良，因为它需要同情心，和平共处是可能的，因为我已经在我的心灵和思想中看到了它，即使它在现实世界中还没有成为现实。寒冷来临，我准备在空闲时间冬眠
我知道我会花很多时间在梦想上，我希望你也会这么做
